model Definition
model Definition · 5 fields
margin
EBIT after ongoing SBC, depreciation and R&D, before interest; no automatic non-GAAP EBITDA substitution
sales To Capital
Incremental revenue / net operating reinvestment, not revenue / gross capital spending
tax
Normalized cash tax rate on positive operating profit; model existing losses/NOLs separately, no cash tax benefit for losses without realizability
stable Reinvestment
g / terminal ROIC of NOPAT; terminal capital efficiency reconciled with margin/tax
sales To Capital Fade
After the explicitly specified capital-efficiency years, fade linearly to terminal ROIC / [terminal EBIT margin × (1 − normalized tax)] by the last forecast year.

wacc Status
Scenario judgment; not estimated market beta/spread. Growth-company operating and financing risk warrant explicit sensitivity, not false precision.
formula
Cost of equity = USD risk-free + assumed beta × chosen ERP; WACC also depends on debt weights/cost and normalized tax. No current beta or debt spread measured.
valuation Gates
valuation Gates · 5 records
  1. Full cash/principal/excess-share conversion bridge at a common date is required before per-share valuation.
  2. Include approximately 2.9m NVIDIA preferred common-equivalents once; no automatic additional $2bn senior claim.
  3. 89.7m common as of August14 is not current October fully diluted shares; 102m next-quarter diluted assumption is a forecast denominator, not spot outstanding.
  4. Review remaining capped calls and subsequent conversion notices; do not mix June debt with later diluted share totals.
  5. FY2027 started before the cutoff. Model the October 17 valuation stub and avoid discounting an entire already-started fiscal year as if wholly future.
uncertainties
uncertainties · 4 records
  1. Component scarcity pricing may be cyclical, and new supply may reduce margins.
  2. Current management call OCS/CPO milestones remain conditional on qualification/delivery.
  3. Incremental sales/capital is a modeling judgment; new fabs and larger working capital can depress it.
  4. Mature 14% ROIC exceeds chosen WACC modestly and needs lasting product differentiation.
not Used
not Used · 4 records
  1. Current share price as calibration target
  2. Unverified consensus forecasts
  3. Unwatched video claims
  4. Arbitrary management credibility multipliers

rationale
rationale · 10 fields
growth
35% is well below FY2026 growth of 83% and the latest 109% quarter. It still compounds into a much larger business over ten years; optical adoption supports growth but current capacity shortages are not permanent.
target Margin
25% improves on FY2026 annual GAAP EBIT margin of 17.4% but is below the latest quarter’s 27.8%. It preserves operating leverage without using non-GAAP guidance as GAAP EBIT.
tax
22% is a normalized profitable-company assumption. Recent loss periods and the FY2026 tax benefit do not support a negative long-run cash-tax rate.
sales Capital
1.2x requires about $0.83 of net reinvestment per added $1 of sales. Capacity additions and working capital make the ramp less capital-light than a pure design/software business.
terminal ROIC
14% retains a limited technology advantage while allowing competition and product replacement to erode peak returns.
wacc
11.5% nominal USD is a rounded model estimate. Assumed beta 1.6, 15% target debt and a 2.5-point debt spread reflect a concentrated, volatile optical cycle and financing exposure.
terminal Growth
2.5% nominal USD is a mature-state assumption with limited real expansion, well below the high-growth starting rate and the discount rate; it is not a company forecast.
years
10 years is the common model horizon so company economics can be compared; rates and margins fade over this period. The number is a modeling convention, not a source fact.
other Claims
0 is an unreviewed placeholder, not evidence that no additional claims exist. Review convertible-note conversion, capped-call treatment and employee dilution without counting the same instrument as both full debt and converted equity.
other Assets
0 is an unreviewed placeholder, not a statement that all non-operating assets are absent or worthless. Review assets not already included in snapshot cash and avoid double counting.
